title: VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition
body_html:
VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition includes two years of VIVE Business Warranty & Services (BWS), which gives you access to VIVE Business+ software and services. BWS is required for commercial use.** See Terms & Conditions.

Thanks to inside-out tracking, setup is easy. Auto-IPD adjustment delivers seamless device sharing between users. A reinforced design, hot-swappable battery, easy-to-clean gaskets, and active cooling minimize headset downtime in high-traffic environments.


View full product details ›

 

Highlights at a glance

Integrated eye tracking

Built-in eye tracking enables auto-IPD adjustment, speeding up onboarding. It also supports foveated rendering and eye-movement analytics for improved VR training and collaboration.1

Depth-correct mixed reality

Make interactions with virtual objects in real-world spaces more natural and immersive using full-color, stereo passthrough cameras, and a built-in depth sensor.

Visually lossless graphics

Experience high-quality, visually lossless 5K PC VR graphics with VIVE Wired Streaming Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible).2 VIVE Wired Streaming Kit sold separately.

Elevated immersion

Enhance XR experiences with features like IR-illuminated hand tracking and VIVE accessories for full-body and object tracking.

Streamlined management

Optimize your operation with remote monitoring, setting updates, and advanced features3 from VIVE Business+ device management solution.

Trusted VIVE production

HTC prioritizes privacy and security. All VIVE headsets are manufactured in a TAA-designated region and meet the requirements set forth by Section 889 of the NDAA in the USA.

 

Details:

  1. Content compatibility required. Please check the specifications to ensure the content supports eye tracking and related functions like foveated rendering. Performance may vary by title or application and may be affected by eye surgery, eye disease, heavy makeup, and/or high myopia.
  2. PC VR content is accessible via VIVE Business Streaming (or VIVE Streaming within VIVE Hub) on PC. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. Latency and visual quality of VR/MR content are dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection. To connect to a PC via DisplayPort, VIVE Focus Vision also requires VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible) and VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible), both of which are included in VIVE Wired Streaming Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible).
  3. An upgrade is required to unlock VIVE Business+ Pro and Ultimate Tiers advanced features.

VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition – FAQs


Is VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition enterprise-ready?
Yes. It includes centralized device management, enterprise support, and business-grade security for large-scale deployments.

Is VIVE Focus Vision a standalone VR headset?
Yes. It operates fully standalone with no PC or external hardware required. It also supports PC-VR streaming.*

Does VIVE Focus Vision support eye tracking?
Yes. Built-in eye tracking enables training analytics, research insights, and performance optimization through foveated rendering.*

What are the primary use cases for VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition?
Location-Based Entertainment (LBE) for arcades and entertainment centers, Government & Public Safety use cases including training, simulation, and mission-critical visualization, and other applications that require a robust, multiuser VR experience.

Is this headset suitable for government and public safety organizations?
Yes. It is designed for government, defense, and public safety deployments requiring secure, managed XR hardware.

Is VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition TAA compliant?
Yes. All VIVE headsets are manufactured in a TAA-designated region and meet the requirements set forth by Section 889 of the NDAA in the United States.

How does the Business Edition differ from consumer VR headsets?
VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition is built for commercial use, offering enterprise device management, business-grade support, and VIVE Business Warranty & Services (BWS), which is available to, and required for, customers using VIVE Focus Vision for commercial purposes.

How does this differ from Meta Quest 3 and 3S headsets?
VIVE Focus Vision features built-in eye tracking, a durable alloy chassis, a hot-swappable battery, easy-to-clean magnetic gaskets, and an active cooling system designed to minimize headset downtime in high-traffic environments.

Who is this headset designed for?
Enterprises, government & public safety organizations, and location-based experience operators using VR for training and simulation, manufacturing workflows, remote collaboration, and immersive design and visualization.

Is it compatible with enterprise XR applications and workflows?
Yes. It supports leading enterprise XR applications and professional deployment workflows.

* Content compatibility required.
